title: When LLM Reward Design Fails: Diagnostic-Driven Refinement for Sparse Structured RL
abstract: arXiv:2605.28918v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For sparse, structured reinforcement-learning tasks with semantic reward-function interfaces, LLM-generated reward shaping is better framed as debugging than one-shot generation. We study PPO-trained agents using MiniGrid as core evaluation and MuJoCo reaching/locomotion as boundary stress tests. Our qualitative audit finds two recurring one-shot failure modes -- reward flooding and semantic/API misunderstanding -- and a rarer, less reliably distinguished weak-shaping case. We propose diagnostic-driven iterative refinement, using training diagnostics and a failure-mode taxonomy to guide reward-function revision. On sparse structured tasks with diagnosable reward failures, refinement improves DoorKey-8x8 from 2.3% success without shaping to 97.6%, and KeyCorridor from 31.2% one-shot to 86.7% with high seed-to-seed variance. Controls show these gains are not from generic retrying or extra training alone: metrics-only re-prompting

translated_title: 当LLM奖励设计失败时：面向稀疏结构化强化学习的诊断驱动式改进
translated_abstract: 对于具有语义奖励函数接口的稀疏、结构化强化学习任务，LLM生成的奖励塑形更适合被框定为一个调试过程，而非一次性生成。我们研究了使用PPO训练的智能体，以MiniGrid作为核心评估环境，并以MuJoCo的抓取/运动任务作为边界压力测试。我们的定性审计发现了两种反复出现的一次性失败模式——奖励泛滥和语义/API误解——以及一种更罕见、较难可靠区分的弱塑形情况。我们提出了诊断驱动的迭代改进方法，利用训练诊断信息和失败模式分类法来指导奖励函数的修订。在具有可诊断奖励失败的稀疏结构化任务上，该改进方法将DoorKey-8x8的成功率从无塑形时的2.3%提升至97.6%，将KeyCorridor从一次性生成的31.2%提升至86.7%（但种子间方差较高）。对照实验表明，这些提升并非仅来自简单的重试或额外的训练：仅基于指标重新提示...
tldr: 本文提出诊断驱动的迭代改进方法，通过失败模式分类和训练诊断信息来系统性修正LLM生成的奖励函数，将稀疏结构化强化学习任务的成功率从2.3%大幅提升至97.6%，证明了LLM奖励设计应被视为调试过程而非一次性生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diagnostic-driven iterative refinement approach that uses training diagnostics and a failure-mode taxonomy to systematically revise LLM-generated reward functions, boosting success rates on sparse structured RL tasks from 2.3% to 97.6%, demonstrating that LLM reward design should be treated as debugging rather than one-shot generation.
